Select the tar program used to unpack a .tar.gz runtime archive

Source: R/install.R
extract_tar_program.Rd

Windows ships bsdtar (libarchive) at System32\\tar.exe. It handles the PAX / long-name records in python-build-standalone archives that R's internal tar cannot (those surface as "embedded nul in string" errors), and unlike a GNU tar from Git for Windows it does not misparse C:\\... paths as remote hosts. Fall back to R's internal tar only when bsdtar is unavailable. On macOS / Linux the system tar (bsdtar or GNU tar) already handles PAX records, including the Apple com.apple.cs.CodeSignature xattrs in portable R archives.

Usage

extract_tar_program(
  os_type = .Platform$OS.type,
  system_root = Sys.getenv("SystemRoot", unset = "C:\\Windows")
)

Arguments

os_type

Operating system family, defaulting to .Platform$OS.type.

system_root

Windows system root, defaulting to the SystemRoot environment variable.

Value

A value suitable for the tar argument of utils::untar(): a path to a tar executable, the string "internal", or the result of Sys.which().
